# Dmitrii Ilenkov

> Author, TEDx speaker and entrepreneur based in Belgrade, Serbia. Co-founder of pmclub, an online school for project and product managers with more than 30,000 students. Co-author, with Valeria Ilenkova, of "Keep It Simple! Project Management with P3.express" (Bombora, 2026, in Russian; ISBN 978-5-04-228544-8). Accredited P3.express trainer; reviewer of the PMBOK Guide, 7th and 8th editions.
